ac.text: The inventory page shows the title "Products" and 6 products. Each product shows an image, a name, a description, a price and an "Add to cart" button.
cases: SD-102: Verify inventory page shows title and six products with image, name, description, price and Add to cart

ac.text: A sort control offers four options: Name (A to Z), Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), Price (high to low). The default is Name (A to Z).
cases: SD-102: Verify sort control lists four options and defaults to Name (A to Z)
SD-102: Verify the sort option resets to Name (A to Z) after returning from a product detail page (state)

ac.text: Selecting a sort option reorders the product list immediately.
cases: SD-102: Verify Name (A to Z) orders products alphabetically
SD-102: Verify Name (Z to A) orders products reverse alphabetically
SD-102: Verify Price (low to high) orders products by ascending price
SD-102: Verify Price (high to low) orders products by descending price
SD-102: Verify selecting a sort option reorders the list without leaving the page
SD-102: Verify sorting keeps the Remove state of items already in the cart (interaction)
SD-102: Verify the sort option resets to Name (A to Z) after returning from a product detail page (state)

ac.text: The two Name options order products alphabetically by product name.
cases: SD-102: Verify Name (A to Z) orders products alphabetically
SD-102: Verify Name (Z to A) orders products reverse alphabetically

ac.text: The two Price options order products numerically by price.
cases: SD-102: Verify Price (low to high) orders products by ascending price
SD-102: Verify Price (high to low) orders products by descending price
SD-102: Verify products with equal prices fall back to Name (A to Z) order (boundary - price tie)

ac.text: Clicking "Add to cart" on a product changes that button to "Remove" and increases the cart badge count by 1.
cases: SD-102: Verify Add to cart changes the button to Remove and shows a cart badge of 1
SD-102: Verify cart badge counts up to 6 when all products are added (boundary - maximum)
SD-102: Verify Remove changes the button back to Add to cart and decreases the badge
SD-102: Verify sorting keeps the Remove state of items already in the cart (interaction)

ac.text: Clicking "Remove" changes the button back to "Add to cart" and decreases the cart badge count by 1.
cases: SD-102: Verify Remove changes the button back to Add to cart and decreases the badge

ac.text: When the cart is empty, no badge is shown on the cart icon.
cases: SD-102: Verify no cart badge is shown after the last item is removed (boundary - empty cart)

ac.text: Clicking a product name opens that product's detail page, showing its name, description and price. "Back to products" returns to the inventory page.
cases: SD-102: Verify clicking a product name opens its detail page with name, description and price
SD-102: Verify Back to products returns to the inventory page

ac.text: Cart contents persist while the user moves between the inventory page and product detail pages.
cases: SD-102: Verify cart contents persist between inventory and product detail pages

ac.text: Clicking the cart icon opens the cart page.
cases: SD-102: Verify clicking the cart icon opens the cart page

ac.text: Choosing Logout from the menu returns the user to the login page.
cases: SD-102: Verify Logout returns the user to the login page

ac.text: A logged-out user who opens the inventory page address directly stays on the login page and sees an error that the page can only be accessed when logged in.
cases: SD-102: Verify a logged-out user cannot open the inventory page directly (Negative)

ac.text: The inventory page layout is responsive down to a 375px-wide viewport.
ac.reason: Layout judgment is a visual check, which fails the triage gate "deterministic outcome". Filed as a manual case: MANUAL — SD-102: Verify inventory layout at 375px width.
